bullets.text: Ponneri: A family staged a dharna demanding compensation after a contract worker was injured at the Kattupalli desalination plant.
Gummidipoondi and Thiruvallur experienced severe four-hour power cuts causing public outrage and road blockades.
Two persons were killed in an accident on the Maduravoyal bypass road near Vanagaram after a motorist hit a truck.
Velachery: Police arrested a couple for committing a theft at a doctor's house and remanded them to judicial custody.
Adyar Gandhi Nagar residents stepped out to walk through streets and assess neighbourhood green cover and tree damage.
Thiruttani: A 38-year-old farmer named Bhoopalan from Thalavedu village died by suicide after suffering from stomach ailments.
Gummidipoondi BDO office distributed 24 new vehicles to 21 village panchayats for garbage collection funded by CSR.
Ponneri municipality faced delays in issuing work orders for tendered projects leaving residents struggling without infrastructure.
Bengaluru planned a massive seventy-acre AI city, prompting questions about Chennai's competitive position in technology.
Tamil Nadu ranked among states with the highest share of workers in occupations where AI improves productivity.
Suzlon announced a five hundred fifty crore investment in three AI-powered blade factories including in Tamil Nadu.
Chennai: Student federation members protesting to remove Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar were detained after scuffles.
Congress leaders attempting to protest Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Chennai visit were placed under house arrest.
AIADMK leader Edappadi K. Palaniswami criticized shifting political stances, noting infrastructure projects initiated during AIADMK tenure.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay travelled together on the newly inaugurated Chennai Metro train.
Prime Minister Modi inaugurated the four thousand nine hundred crore rupees Chennai Metro Phase II stretch during his visit.
Chief Minister Vijay welcomed Prime Minister Modi at the airport and presented key demands during the official visit.
